recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR-14019 follow-up is needed in core unless a future work group decision changes obs-7 semantics rather than wording.
issue_request: FHIR-14019 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Observation issue asking to clarify the ambiguous obs-7 human text "If code is the same as a component code..." by naming Observation.code and Observation.component.code.
initial_application: Commit 9973be692f historically applied the issue to the then-authoritative Observation spreadsheet text by changing the ambiguous wording to mention Observation.code and Observation.component.code.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-38955 refined the same obs-7 description and commit a70a01bf43 applied the current wording in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-38955 audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active StructureDefinition already says Observation.component.code is compared with Observation.code and that Observation.value SHALL NOT be present when they are the same.

related_jiras.note: Later Published R5 issue that intentionally refined the same obs-7 wording to the current text.
